gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-mooli: One constant pen width runs through every Balsamiq Sans letter, bold and loose. Mooli's round, open letters stay clear at small sizes, so paragraph after paragraph moves along without squinting.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-nanum-gothic: Stencil-cut boldness, and not one pinched curve in the Balsamiq Sans headings. And Nanum Gothic lets wide channels lead into each counter, giving the text a professional, contemporary footing.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Balsamiq Sans lays down identical bar thickness all across the line, loud and loose. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi then slips beneath it, approachable and uncluttered in every small counter.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-mongol: A unit-width stroke gives Balsamiq Sans its bold, expressive look. Noto Sans Mongolian settles in underneath, its terminals flaring outward in a modern way that loosens the heading's insistence.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-quattrocento-san: Balsamiq Sans draws a tube-like stroke resembling neon glass, bold and expressive, with no tight pinched curves anywhere. It catches the eye; Quattrocento Sans keeps c from looking like o.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-spinnaker: Expressive from the first letter, Balsamiq Sans never shifts weight along a curve. Spinnaker's apertures keep counters connected to the space outside, and that shared openness is what ties the two together.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-suse-mono: Bold, expressive, and drawn with one tip, Balsamiq Sans is simple in every glyph. SUSE Mono gives every letter extra room on both sides, so paragraphs read at a relaxed, approachable pace.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tajawal: Balsamiq Sans gives horizontals the weight of verticals, a bold, expressive habit that never lets up. Tajawal, its c curled like a broad open hook, keeps a full page of text clean and unfussy.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tasa-explorer: Every curve in Balsamiq Sans carries the same heft as its straight stems. TASA Explorer, its curves ending like brush strokes lifted early, feels lighter and friendlier beside that loud heading.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-varela: Balsamiq Sans is bold and expressive, its stencil-cut weight never pinching a curve anywhere along the line. Varela's wide-mouthed c shapes and one-width t keep paragraphs modern and approachable.
